notes.title: Launching in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[p]🎉 [b]The Storyteller is now available in Early Access![/b] 🎉[/p][p]I'm proud (and a bit anxious!) to announce that [b]The Storyteller[/b] has finally arrived on Steam in Early Access![/p][p]This game was entirely developed by a single person, with lots of dedication and care. Your participation is essential to shape the future of this experience![/p][p]⚠️ [b]Remember:[/b] This is NOT the final version of the game. Your opinions, ideas, criticism, and suggestions are very welcome to help make it even better. Don't hesitate to share your feedback![/p][p]📖 [b]Want to be part of the story?[/b]
Submit your own mysterious and tragicomic stories for a chance to see them come to life in the game—with your name immortalized in the credits![/p][p]Thanks for your support, and see you in the mysterious and darkly humorous world of [b]The Storyteller[/b]![/p]

notes.title: The Storyteller - Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
🕵️‍♂️ The Storyteller is coming to Steam Next Fest!
Get ready for dark mysteries, unexpected twists, and hilarious deduction battles with your friends.
👥 Play as the Narrator or an Investigator and uncover (or conceal) the truth.

📅 Play the demo during Steam Next Fest!
Add it to your wishlist and don’t miss the experience!
